notes: Inbound from self-serve signup (trial credits used) — signed up 2026-01-28, got automated onboarding email.
Product discovery call 2026-02-14 (FF-20260214-CPSW-call-01). AE Jordan + SE Maya on call. CTO (Ravi Patel) and Eng lead (Leah Ortiz) attended.
Primary ask: lower inference costs for chat-heavy support assistant. High token churn from verbose customer transcripts.
Workload profile: real-time chat assistant (agent-assist + auto-responses) + nightly embedding index of tickets for semantic search. Peak concurrent users ~20-40 during business hours.
Latency targets: p50 ~ <250ms for 1-2 turn bot responses; p95 can be up to 700ms. Cost sensitivity: high — monthly run-rate target <$1k during POC, want predictable per-conversation cost.

Model preference: open quantized models if accuracy ok (they asked about q4_0 / int8); also open to Redwood recommended 'small+cache' combos. Quote: 'We need cheap enough to scale to 5k conv/mo without exploding spend.'
Optimization asks observed on call:
- batching: want examples/configs for grouping parallel agent requests (50 simultaneous dev agents in staging).
- caching: prefix + KV cache patterns, cache TTLs for common replies, how to hook caching into existing message store.
- prompt compression: examples for extracting minimal context from multi-message threads, safe truncation heuristics, automated summarization before send.
- token usage audits: want an automated token breakdown per flow and per route; want suggestions for where to shorten prompts.
Security/Compliance: public cloud ok but legal asked for short DPA addendum and basic audit logging. No on-prem requirement for now.

POC scope proposed by Redwood (high level): 1) run 2-week token audit on production traffic via hosted API; 2) prototype batching config in sandbox; 3) implement prefix caching for top-100 templates; 4) quantify estimated monthly cost after optimizations.
Notes from engineering: current implementation sends entire 20-message thread each request (avg 1.8k tokens). They have a pre-existing embeddings pipeline (daily job) built in-house.
Action items captured:
- Jordan to send POC agreement + $2k credit offer (sent 2026-02-18) — awaiting signature from RevOps.
- Maya to produce sample batching config + recommended batch_size/timeout for dev/staging (deliver by 2026-03-12).
- SE: prepare token audit script and example report template; propose safe prompt-compression patterns.
- Legal: receive DPA addendum draft from Redwood (attached in drive link).
Recent update 2026-03-09: RevOps asked for clearer pass/fail criteria for POC (cost reduced >=30% at parity of answer quality). They want side-by-side convo quality checks.
Quote from CTO Ravi: 'If you can shave tokens by 40% without making agents hallucinate, we can move to monthly plan.'
Potential win: if we can demonstrate 30-50% cost reduction via prompt compression + KV caching, they convert to paid hosted plan and enable Optimize add-on.
Risks: their current frontend ties message rendering to full transcript — dev work required to implement compressed context. They may not want additional infra changes during POC.
Suggested AE script for follow-up: focus on small wins (top-10 templates caching), show cost math, run token audit within 72 hours after signed POC.
Internal notes: keep POC narrow to avoid scope creep; provide concrete before/after token counts on sample conversations; include eval checklist for quality regression.
